Definition: the body (as being rolled together); also powerful
BiblicalUsage: Nebuchadnezzar carried away the mighty of the land to Babylon, and the psalmist says of the wicked that there are no bands in their death, but their strength is firm.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bulk and power impress men far more than they impress God: a firm body and an easy death are no sign of a right life, and the psalm says so plainly.
